input.summary: Build bonus through the top-right arc and return lanes, hit A and B for double bonus, then repeatedly collect the doubled value at the upper-left saucer, which pays bonus without resetting it.

quickInfo.name: Skill shot
quickInfo.summary: The center top lane lights both side bumpers; either outside lane lights the opposite bumper.

quickInfo.name: Bonus advances
quickInfo.summary: The three top-right arc buttons, both return lanes, and two advance-bonus standups each add 1,000.

quickInfo.name: Double bonus
quickInfo.summary: Hitting both A and B standups beside the center saucer lights double bonus until the ball ends or the game is tilted.

quickInfo.name: Reusable collect
quickInfo.summary: The upper-left bonus hole collects the current bonus without resetting its lit value.

quickInfo.name: Outhole reset
quickInfo.summary: The outhole collects the current bonus, then resets the base value to 1,000 for the next ball.

steps.text: Plunge the center top lane when possible to light both side bumpers.
From the left flipper, shoot the top-right arc and cross its three white rollover buttons.
Use return-lane and advance-bonus switches to keep building base bonus.
Delay the A and B standups until the base bonus is high enough to justify their rebound risk.
Hit both A and B to light double bonus.
From the right flipper, shoot the upper-left bonus saucer.
Confirm that the saucer collects bonus without resetting the lit base value.
Repeat the upper-left saucer while its return remains safe, rebuilding through the top-right arc as needed.

fallback.title: Base-bonus survival plan
fallback.when: Use this plan when the A-B standups or upper-left saucer are rebounding toward the center.

steps.text: Continue the broad top-right arc from the left flipper.
Take return-lane and side-target advances through natural play.
Let the outhole collect the accumulated base bonus if no controlled collect appears.
Reattempt A-B only after the ball reaches a stable flipper feed.

alternatives.title: Undoubled saucer collect
alternatives.when: Use this plan when base bonus is high but one A-B target has proved too dangerous on this machine.

steps.text: Preserve the built base bonus instead of forcing the missing standup.
Shoot the upper-left bonus saucer from a controlled right-flipper feed.
Confirm that the base value remains lit after the collect.
Repeat the safer saucer or return to top-right bonus advances.
Build base bonus through the top-right arc, return lanes, and advance targets.
Hit A and B to light double bonus.
Collect the doubled value at the upper-left saucer.
Use the non-resetting saucer collect to preserve the base value.
Repeat the collect while the ball remains controlled.

techniques.name: Top-right arc feed
techniques.instruction: From the left flipper, send the ball through the broad right arc with enough speed to cross the white rollover buttons without striking their outside posts.

techniques.name: A-B timing
techniques.instruction: Wait until base bonus is valuable, then shoot only the missing A or B target from a settled ball. Stop after both lamps confirm double bonus.

techniques.name: Non-resetting collect check
techniques.instruction: After the upper-left saucer scores, read the bonus ladder before the next flip. Continue only if the expected base value remains lit.

cautions.issue: A missed center-saucer shot can rebound toward the drain, and a made ball may pass through the opening.
cautions.response: Ignore the center saucer's 5,000-point award unless the machine presents an unusually safe feed.

cautions.issue: A and B are valuable but expose the ball to standup-target rebounds.
cautions.response: Build base bonus first, then take one deliberate target shot from control rather than repeated on-the-fly attempts.

cautions.issue: Balls falling from the upper area can leave the smooth side paths and enter the center unpredictably.
cautions.response: Track every top exit and prepare both flippers before the ball clears the bumpers.

input.simpleOverview: Delta Queen raises base bonus through the top-right arc, return lanes, and Advance Bonus standups. Build the base first, hit both A and B for Double Bonus, then repeat the upper-left bonus saucer because its collect does not reset the value.
input.overview: In Delta Queen, the upper-left saucer scores the built bonus without resetting it, while the drain collect resets the base. Use the left flipper for the top-right arc and its three buttons, delay A-B until the base is valuable, then light Double Bonus and repeat the saucer from the right flipper. Stop when its return no longer reaches control.
